item.title: Kia Posts Highest Growth Among Mainstream Auto Brands In The Philippines In 2025
item.description: Kia Philippines, a subsidiary of ACMobility, posted 16.7 percent year-on-year growth in 2025, emerging as the fastest-growing mainstream established automotive brand in the country. Retail sales rose from 6,692 units in 2024 to 7,810 units in 2025, reflecting strong consumer confidence in Kia’s vehicles and the brand’s ability to deliver value, innovation, and reliability to Filipino motorists.Read More »
